comparison.P0_reuse: reuse accepted P0 fit table, ranked queries, per-query metrics and aggregates byte-for-byte; no refit or reranking
comparison.C1_independent_count_audit: separate acceptance oracle, not another primary fit or candidate

P0_identity.interpretation: existing accepted development reference, not a new fit or unseen baseline result

cooccurrence_counts.input: accepted baskets.csv plus accepted source identities; only canonical view-derived basket memberships

source_columns.memberships: items JSON array of distinct canonical numeric-ID strings

cooccurrence_counts.session_definition: parent view-only 30-minute sessions; strictly greater than 1800000 ms starts a new session, equality stays; do not reconstruct from carts/transactions
cooccurrence_counts.fit_session_set: B_s = distinct item IDs in accepted view baskets with role=train and fit_start <= timestamp < fit_end, grouped by unchanged accepted session key
cooccurrence_counts.boundary_policy: clip each session to eligible train prefix; ignore warmup and validation members; never use final session length/end or future members to select, merge or delete a session
cooccurrence_counts.singleton_sessions: contribute item support S_i even though they emit no pair
cooccurrence_counts.item_support: S_i = number of eligible train session sets B_s containing i; one contribution per item/session regardless of repeat views or timestamps
cooccurrence_counts.pair_support: C_ij = number of eligible train session sets B_s containing both distinct i and j; one contribution per unordered pair/session
cooccurrence_counts.unordered_pair_storage: canonical numeric item ID order i<j; C_ij=C_ji on lookup; no diagonal self pair C_ii
cooccurrence_counts.same_timestamp: items in one unordered same-millisecond view basket may cooccur; do not invent click order
cooccurrence_counts.statistics_meaning: session association, not directed next-click transition counts or calibrated purchase probabilities
cooccurrence_counts.extra_filters: none: no bots/activity/k-core removal, recency weighting, window search, rare-item pruning or validation-dependent filtering
count_invariants: S_i positive integers; key set equals accepted P0 positive-fit item key set, including singleton-only items
0 < C_ij <= min(S_i,S_j) for stored distinct pairs
cooccurrence_counts.resource_preflight: before real fit, report train-only session cardinalities and exact pair-emission work; bind disk/memory/runtime limits in implementation entry; exact chunking/spill inside shop allowed, silently capping/pruning/sampling is forbidden; insufficient resources stop execution or require a new method protocol

causal_query_history.source: accepted baskets.csv joined on visitorid/session_start_ms; verify basket_index against accepted query
causal_query_history.history_set: H(q) = distinct union of all view basket items in the same accepted session with basket_index <= query basket_index and timestamp <= query_ms
causal_query_history.item_multiplicity: each distinct history item contributes once; no repeat-view amplification, last-N cap, decay or history-length search
causal_query_history.cross_role_past_context: same-session warmup/train/past-validation context may be used only when already observed by query time; it never updates S_i or C_ij
causal_query_history.unknown_visitor: use current valid session context even if visitor was unseen at fit cutoff; no long-term user model or population exclusion
causal_query_history.unknown_history_item: keep in history trace; if S_i absent it contributes exact zero, not division by zero or a reason to drop query
causal_query_history.empty_history: invalid for the accepted nonempty current-basket query contract; stop on missing/empty join rather than hiding a data error as fallback
forbidden_inputs: P0 per-query metric or known hit status
whole-training activity or seen flags as ranking features

ranking_and_fallback.candidate_catalog: identical parent C(q): all catalog.csv IDs with first_view_ms < query_ms; no future/property-only items, availability filter, negative sampling or target injection
ranking_and_fallback.score: A_q(j) = sum over distinct i in H(q), i!=j and S_i>0, of C_ij/S_i; missing pair contributes zero
ranking_and_fallback.arithmetic: exact reduced rational numerator/denominator; compare by exact fractions/cross-products, no floating score tie tolerance
ranking_and_fallback.score_interpretation: nonnegative association score, may exceed one; not a probability of next view, purchase or conversion
ranking_and_fallback.self_pair: no self-edge contribution, but history item remains a candidate and may receive evidence from other history items or P0 tie/fill
ranking_and_fallback.full_fallback: if no causal candidate has positive A score, ranking exactly equals accepted P0 for that query's complete causal catalog
ranking_and_fallback.partial_fallback: positive A-score candidates rank first; if fewer than K, fill zero-score candidates by frozen P0 count then numeric ID, excluding already selected IDs; not merely append a truncated P0 list
ranking_and_fallback.unknown_candidate_item: retain in C(q), score zero and P0 count zero when absent; same numeric-ID tie rule
ranking_and_fallback.empty_catalog: return empty list; keep valid nonempty-target query with zero retrieval metrics
ranking_and_fallback.list_size: min(10, |C(q)|) unique IDs; exact complete-catalog total-order top K
ranking_and_fallback.exact_optimization: sparse accumulation over all neighbors of history seeds plus exact P0 zero-fill is allowed only with all-candidate count and exact ranking proof; no neighbor top-L, history cap or sampled catalog

paired_evaluation.roster: accepted queries.csv exact validation role only; bind complete CSV hash and immutable role filter
paired_evaluation.join: one-to-one complete key/order equality with accepted P0 ranked_queries/query_metrics; missing/extra/duplicate keys stop, never inner-join away difficult cases
paired_evaluation.targets_and_candidates: same complete target set and causal candidate count per query for both methods; unreachable targets remain in Recall and full-target IDCG
paired_evaluation.primary_estimand: Delta_Q = mean over all fixed validation queries of (NDCG_C1(q)-NDCG_P0(q))
secondary: catalog coverage difference on common candidate-union denominator
paired_evaluation.metric_definitions: unchanged parent P0 v1 formulas, binary full-target relevance, K=10; no new definition or data cleaning
paired_evaluation.catalog_coverage_denominator: common validation causal candidate union 222754; coverage difference is difference of two union-based coverages, not average per-query coverage
paired_evaluation.conditional: same 161211 queries whose entire target set is causal-catalog reachable; paired descriptive results with separate denominators, never replace main
paired_evaluation.structural_coverage: both methods must reproduce the same target/catalog reachability counts; changing recommendation scores cannot change them
paired_evaluation.exact_fields: counts, item/query keys, histories, rational scores and ordered lists must match exactly; null cases explicit, NaN/Infinity forbidden

fixed_validation.interpretation: copied from accepted P0/data receipts; C1 item-support keys must equal P0 positive keys, so these historical support partitions remain identical

uncertainty.cluster_key: anonymous visitorid; include every validation query of a selected visitor together in both arms
uncertainty.cluster_order: ascending numeric visitorid over exactly 62235 validation visitor keys
uncertainty.draw: for each replicate in order, rng.integers(0,V,size=V,dtype=np.int64) from np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(42)); V=62235
uncertainty.replicate_formula: for each visitor v let n_v=query count and d_v=sum paired NDCG deltas; with draw multiplicity w_v, Delta_b=sum_v w_v*d_v / sum_v w_v*n_v
uncertainty.numeric_reduction: binary64 C1 NDCG minus round-trip parsed accepted P0 NDCG; main mean uses math.fsum in accepted query order; d_v uses math.fsum in accepted within-visitor query order; weighted numerator uses math.fsum(w_v*d_v in numeric visitor order), denominator uses exact integers; percentile input is float64 replicate order
uncertainty.query_weighting: ratio of weighted sums; do not average visitor means for the query-macro estimand, do not sample queries independently
uncertainty.draw_audit: per replicate hash indices as canonical little-endian signed int64 C-order bytes; preserve before/after RNG state, sampled query denominator and delta; independent oracle regenerates identical draw hashes and recomputes all replicates
uncertainty.interpretation: development resampling interval conditional on already observed validation visitors, not pristine holdout, independent-person, causal or business evidence; report interval across zero or unfavorable result unchanged

slice_support_and_diagnostics.inherited_slices: same visitor seen/new, original train-only 0/1/2-5/6+ activity, current/target basket one/multiple and shared positive-fit-item target coverage; pair every query, report query and unique visitor counts
additional_diagnostics: distinct history size and supported-seed count
number of causal candidates with positive cooccurrence evidence
full fallback reason: no supported seeds vs supported seeds with no positive causal neighbor
positive-evidence count 0 / 1-9 / at least 10 and zero-score fill slots
history/evidence/fallback partitions remain diagnostics, never filters
slice_support_and_diagnostics.support_floor: max(50,ceil(166897/100))=1669 queries; separately report visitors and target occurrences
slice_support_and_diagnostics.small_groups: validation current/target multiple items 56/53 and mixed positive/zero targets 3 queries are descriptive-only; original train 199/192 and locked test 33/29 limitations retained
slice_support_and_diagnostics.empty_slice: null metrics with explicit no-sample reason
slice_support_and_diagnostics.inference: no slice significance, CI-based slice picking, post-hoc merging, dropping or tuning; bootstrap only for prespecified overall paired primary delta

reserved_test.rule: paired validation completion or a favorable CI does not open test; preserve parent safeguards and require separately frozen final-choice/refit/test implementation and later explicit test execution scope

fit_outputs: train-only session/item-set lineage and singleton accounting
positive S_i table and unordered integer C_ij table
C1 fit identity and source/code/environment hashes; P0 reused identity
query_outputs: query key and verified prefix-history trace/hash
exact reduced rational scores, P0 tie counts and complete ordered top10
complete-target per-query metric terms and one-to-one P0/C1 deltas
uncertainty_outputs: 2000 replicate deltas, draw hashes and sampled denominators
RNG state and percentile interval recipe
planned_acceptance_and_artifacts.independent_oracle: separate train-prefix session/pair reconstruction, exact rational full-order score oracle and per-query metric/delta readback; recompute entire aggregate and bootstrap, not spot checks
synthetic_cases_before_real_execution: repeat views count once per session, singleton support retained
unordered same-time pair, symmetric counts and zero diagonal
train-cutoff crossing sessions clipped before support/pair decisions
future validation/test members cannot alter fit
same-session query prefix only, current basket included, future history forbidden
unknown seeds and no-evidence full P0 equivalence
partial fallback refills exact zero-score order without duplicates
self-edge excluded while seen items remain candidates
rational score ties resolved by frozen P0 count then numeric ID
one-to-one paired keys, full target and empty candidate denominators
visitor-cluster vs query resampling and weighted-query-ratio hand examples
identical bootstrap draw hashes and percentile computation
planned_acceptance_and_artifacts.execution_reentry: complete outputs verify only; partial evidence preserved, no overwrite, refit or score-based retry
planned_acceptance_and_artifacts.publication: public code/specification/aggregate receipts only; raw data, per-session/item/query pairs, model tables, draws and credentials remain Git ignored inside shop

limitations: P0 validation was already inspected before this C1 design; C1 protocol is fixed before C1 scoring, not before any validation exposure
validation is retrospective development comparison, not untouched test or prospective deployment
anonymous visitor clusters are source keys, not verified independent people
missing ingestion/revision/completeness, exposure/propensity and continuous sellable-inventory evidence
no conversion, revenue or causal lift claim
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 noncommercial attribution and applicable share-alike conditions retained
old Olist/UCI RFM small-group and operational restrictions remain unchanged
change_control: new independent C1/P0 comparison protocol, not edits to frozen P0 v1; preserve baseline code, fit, ranks, metrics and receipts; changing counts, normalization, history, fallback, candidates, denominators, bootstrap or model selection requires a new version before execution
